correctness.rationale: Conditional on system failure before t and at least one survivor, survivor count R_t is asymptotically exactly one: P(R_t=1|event)=1-O(S(t)), as failure rank K is independent of IID order statistics. Conditional survivor maximum survival lies between Q_t=S(t+y)/S(t) and (1+O(S(t)))Q_t uniformly in y, preserving the squared-survival integral. Uniform exponentiated-Weibull tail S(x)=alpha exp[-(x/lambda)^beta](1+O(exp[-(t/lambda)^beta])) for x>=t and incomplete-gamma Laplace endpoint show integral Q_t^2 ~ lambda^beta*t^(1-beta)/(2beta). Multiplication by -1/2 proves the three regimes. Conditional event has positive probability for stated signature; n,alpha,s_i affect only lower terms.
